meta.name: azure-cost
meta.description: Azure cost management: query costs, forecast spending, optimize to reduce waste. WHEN: "Azure costs", "Azure bill", "cost breakdown", "how much am I spending", "forecast spending", "optimize costs", "reduce spending", "orphaned resources", "rightsize VMs", "cost spike", "reduce storage costs", "AKS cost". DO NOT USE FOR: deploying resources, provisioning, diagnostics, or security audits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询并优化 Azure 云支出，降低浪费
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常为 Azure 账单过高而烦恼
copy.tagline_en: Query and optimize Azure cloud spend, reduce waste
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about high Azure bills

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会调用 Azure 成本管理接口,帮你查询历史费用、预测未来支出,并给出省钱建议(如释放闲置资源、缩容虚拟机、降低存储成本)。
howto.when: 当你提到“Azure 费用”“费用明细”“预测支出”等成本相关话题时触发;不用于部署资源、配置、诊断或安全审计。

say.text: 我这个月的 Azure 账单是多少?
say.note: Claude 会查询当前订阅的历史成本。

say.text: 预测一下下个季度我们云上要花多少钱?
say.note: 调用预测接口估算未来支出。

say.text: 帮我看哪些闲置资源可以省钱。
say.note: 走成本优化流程找可缩减项。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query Azure Cost Management APIs to show historical spending, forecast future costs, and suggest ways to reduce waste (e.g., removing orphaned resources, downsizing VMs, lowering storage costs).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about Azure costs, bills, cost breakdowns, forecasts, or optimization. Not for deploying resources, provisioning, diagnostics, or security audits.

say_en.text: What is my Azure bill this month?
say_en.note: Claude queries current subscription historical costs.

say_en.text: Forecast our cloud spend for next quarter.
say_en.note: Uses the forecast API to estimate future costs.

say_en.text: Find idle resources that could save money.
say_en.note: Runs the cost optimization workflow to list savings.
